notes.title: Waxworks - Beta 0.7.0 update
notes.notes:
This is a HUGE UPDATE 0.7.0 BETA
--------------------------------------
New GUI
Improved AI
Added new Egypt level (beta)
Added new Museum level (beta)
Added new Cutscene (more coming)
Added Map (M)
Added 6 Languages (beta)
Skipable dialogues
Improved performance
--------------------------------------
Tons of bugs fixed:
fixed items duplicates
fixed characters duplicates
fixed save game serialization for all items
fixed broken save game system, that required to delete folders
fixed wooden pole that freeze the game (Egypt)
fixed hot coal puzzle (Egypt)
fixed pipe puzzle (Egypt)
fixed scale puzzle (Egypt)
fixed bow puzzle (Egypt)
fixed interaction between Weapons and throwable items
fixed AI spawns references
fixed and improved Quests / Tasks
fixed enemies energy indicator
fixed Map interaction vs Boris dialogue
fixed interaction with second Ancestor (Graveyard)
fixed cursor issues, node reset mouse input
fixed LMB interaction with gates (Mine)
fixed UI panels overlapping, hidden panels
fixed UE4 build issues vs config file
fixed dissolve death effect on enemies
fixed game version builds issues, broken NPC and LMB
fixed levels overall after damaging game core (May 2020 - Dec 2020)
and more...
-----------------------------------------
IMPORTANT:
If you have played old version (2020), you MUST delete WaxworksSE folder:
...AppDataLocalWaxworksSE

notes.title: WAXWORKS 0.35.0 UPDATE
notes.notes:
This update is huge. We are bringing some improvements and new level!

-Enemy spawners
-Simplified character interactions
-Improved melee animations
-New and improved enemy logic and behavior
-New Damage collision mechanic
-New Resource system for characters
-New Hero voice over
-Gameplay effects system
-Several Damage types
-Several Damage Resistances
-Improved dialogue mechanic
-Floating damage visualization
-More complex objective system
-Highlight mechanic for objectives
-Improved game state and user interface transitions
-More user settings (mouse control, subtitles..)
-Improved map to map transition framework
-Simplified loading screens
and Zombies!!
